finding: Existing old-character board-local CPU renderer can be configured to request16fps without character replacement. Yuki GLES is not a compatible drop-in backend for old PNG assets. Neither source support nor existing remote16 proves full board-local16 capacity.

candidate_minimal_config_only.scope: New isolated config only; never overwrite selected production config. Reuse exact original assets/core/facials/native pixel library/player, no material regeneration.
candidate_minimal_config_only.why_no_worker_change: Fresh GTK passes stable_avatar_fps when native_avatar=true. Worker only forces local fallback to8 when an offload object exists; disabled portrait_offload means no offload object is constructed.
candidate_minimal_config_only.business_factory: Existing candidate rejection of enabled remote portrait remains intact; local16 config satisfies ownership but still needs capacity acceptance.

direct_yuki_reuse_blockers: prepare_portrait requires profile_id fuyukiss-yuki-freemote39-frame-mesh and pinned EMS/resx/atlas resource set.
yuki_host.cpp imports E-mote and requires face_eyebrow/face_mouth/face_eye_open/face_cheek/face_talk/arm_type and two authored Japanese idle timelines; old PNG sequences have none of these.
Yuki adapter maps nod/shake/wake completion to a fixed0.8s and has its own emotion/pose/mouth behavior, so substituting it would not preserve old FSM bursts or original tracked39-frame geometry.

Old frame pipeline uses original sequence enter/loop/exit and pool rotation, four body tracks, registered eye/mouth matrices, mouth ROI bilinear warp, eye ROI bicubic warp, body-alpha protection, final affine plus cubic resize. Generic textured-quad replacement does not prove matching sampling/composition.
reusable_yuki_pieces: EGLWindow child X window and GLES2 context lifecycle on GTK thread, with swap pacing.
Latest-one control mailbox concept and generation/track/sequence/audio-sample ownership checks; adapter semantics must remain old-character specific.
gl_option_if_cpu16_fails: A separate PNG layer compositor can reuse only EGL hosting. It must preserve all original coordinate/sampling/alpha/mask/temporal semantics; uploading already CPU-composited full images only replaces presentation and does not remove facial/affine CPU cost. No such compatible backend was implemented or validated by this subtask.

existing_asset_manifest_metadata.note: 188MB compressed/input files is not decoded RAM/VRAM. Per-asset bytes were not revalidated in this read-only source audit; deployment must verify existing complete manifest, not preload all frames unbounded.

Isolated old-local16 actual presentation at423x438 under original state/material/action/PCM/pause/cancel timeline. No acceptable8fps fallback.
Same camera/person/YOLO/face and board ASR/GTCRN/Silero/ECAPA/business load as deployment; measure actual handoff intervals and whole-board CPU/RSS/RTF/tails.
Original39-frame tracked eyes/mouth registration, semantic pool selection, exact burst completion, enter/exit, pause/resume, stale/cancel owner rejection and sink-time mouth position must pass.
Whole16fps and audio capacity success precede switch; if fail retain explicit unresolved rendering gate. Yuki inconclusive wholeCPU A/B does not authorize replacement.
